Twenty-seven houses were razed by fire that broke out on Saturday afternoon, Jan. 24 in Purok Tambipalad, Barangay 10, Bacolod City.

Fire Insp. Jemarie Tapiru, deputy city fire marshal, said that 22 houses were totally destroyed and five were partially damaged.

Fire call was received at 2:19 p.m., but the status was raised to third alarm due to the huge fire. Fire out was declared at 3:28 p.m.

A total of 41 families or 130 individuals have been affected by the blaze that left P237,500 worth of damage, according to the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP)-Bacolod.| via Glazyl Masculino

📷 Chamber Volunteer Fire Brigade
